mapper.select: select a.*, b.PROJECT_NAME as contractName, b.CONTRACT_NO as contractNo, b.CONTRACT_TYPE as contractType, b.CONTRACT_AMOUNT as contractAmount, b.SUM_AMOUNT as contractSumAmount, b.SECOND_LEVEL as contractSecondLevel, b.COUNTERPARTY as contractCounterparty from BIZ_POR_OWNER_SETTLE a left join BIZ_CRM_HETONG b on a.HETONG_ID = b.ID ${ew.customSqlSegment}

select a.*, b.PROJECT_NAME as contractName, b.CONTRACT_NO as contractNo, b.CONTRACT_TYPE as contractType, b.CONTRACT_AMOUNT as contractAmount, b.SUM_AMOUNT as contractSumAmount, b.SECOND_LEVEL as contractSecondLevel, b.COUNTERPARTY as contractCounterparty from BIZ_POR_OWNER_SETTLE a left join BIZ_CRM_HETONG b on a.HETONG_ID = b.ID where a.ID = #{id}

select a.*, b.PROJECT_NAME as contractName, b.CONTRACT_NO as contractNo, b.CONTRACT_TYPE as contractType, b.CONTRACT_AMOUNT as contractAmount, b.SUM_AMOUNT as contractSumAmount, b.SECOND_LEVEL as contractSecondLevel, b.COUNTERPARTY as contractCounterparty from BIZ_POR_OWNER_SETTLE a join BIZ_CRM_HETONG b on a.HETONG_ID = b.ID where b.BIZ_PROJECT_ID = #{bizProjectId} and b.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' and b.STATUS in ('0','1') and a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE'
